visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A tilted flat board with one labeled dot and a subtle grid overlay option. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Point dot: small warm-ink sphere (roughness ~0.4). Name label: thin warm paper tag with ink letter. Grid overlay: faint warm-grey ruled lines at low opacity. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: points as exact locations — a tilted board carries a single dot labeled A; tapping adds more lettered points; a grid overlay enables plotting by row and column.

GEOMETRY: A gently tilted rectangular board as the plane. One small dot sits near center with a floating label 'A'. Tapping the board adds points B, C, D with labels. Points are draggable. A 'grid' toggle overlays faint ruled lines and a 'plot' mode lets the learner drop a point at a chosen row/column. A magnifier ring can zoom over a dot to show it has no thickness.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) point dots; (3) name labels; (4) grid overlay.

CAMERA: three-quarter from above-front, frames the whole board; labels legible. Budget 4-8k triangles. Named nodes: PlaneBoard, Dot_A, Dot_B, Dot_C, Dot_D, Labels, GridOverlay, Magnifier. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
